
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /config  (/provider, /swap)                │
  │  Provider Configuration                     │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Full configuration setup for provider and API key.

  Usage:
    /config

  Details:
    Re-runs the configuration wizard where you can change your AI
    provider and enter a new API key. This is the full setup flow —
    use /switch for a quicker model change.

  Examples:
    $ /config

  Related: /switch  /setup  /free
